answer: Anchor each agent to one code-signing certificate from a certificate authority after identity vetting. It signs a fresh challenge with its key, and three established peers verify the chain, the vetting record, and the signature. One certificate costs $200 to $500 plus days of document checks, so a thousand fake identities burns $200,000 to $500,000 and weeks of paperwork. Renewal repeats the vetting, so a stolen key dies within a year. Think of the canyon pass into a garden: one narrow gate, easy to guard, and a mesa of fake papers collapses when every traveler must show a real seal.
